title: Mercosur
goal: Read how the March 1991 Treaty of Asunción created Mercosur among Argentina, Brazil, Paraguay, and Uruguay, its trade goals, Venezuela's suspended membership, and its persistent Brazil/Argentina-vs-smaller-partners asymmetry.

items: State when and by whom the Treaty of Asunción was signed.
Describe what happened to Venezuela's membership.
